item.title: 1968 Chevrolet Camaro Coupe 4-Speed
item.description: This 1968 Chevrolet Camaro coupe was purchased by the seller's uncle in the early-1970s according to the seller, who took possession of the car in 2017. The body is finished in Corvette Bronze metallic paint and features front and rear spoilers as well as chrome bumpers and moldings. item.title: 1979 Chrysler 300 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1979 Chrysler 300 is one of just over 3,800 special-edition US-market 300 models produced for a single model year. The car was acquired by the seller on BaT in September 2025 following single-family ownership in Oregon. Subsequent work has reportedly included tuning the carburetor and replacing the windshield, battery, rear main seal, and air filter. item.title: 41k-Mile 2002 Mazda MX-5 Miata LS 5-Speed
item.description: This 2002 Mazda MX-5 Miata LS has 41k miles, and it was specified in Pure White over tan leather upholstery. item.description: This 1999 Nissan Silvia Spec-R was imported from Japan to the US and was acquired by the selling dealer in 2025. item.title: Euro 1995 BMW M3 Coupe 5-Speed
item.description: This 1995 BMW M3 is a left-hand-drive, European-specification example that was produced for the Japanese market. It was brought to Canada around 2018 and relocated to the US in 2020 before being acquired by the seller on BaT in January 2021. Power is provided by a 3.0-liter S50B30 inline-six linked to a five-speed manual transmission, and features include Arctic Silver Metallic paintwork, a slicktop roof, and Vader sport seats trimmed in Anthracite M cloth. item.title: 2005 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII GSR
item.description: This 2005 Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution VIII GSR has remained registered in California since new. It was purchased by the seller from the original owner in 2012, and they have since added approximately 35k of the 66k indicated miles. Finished in Apex Silver over Black Ecsaine and Blue cloth, the car is powered by a turbocharged 2.0-liter 4G63 inline-four linked with a five-speed manual transaxle. item.description: This 1963 Jaguar XKE Series I roadster was acquired by the current owner in 1995 and was refurbished between 2020 and 2026. item.title: Fuel-Injected, 351W-Powered 1969 Ford Mustang Mach 1 5-Speed
item.description: This 1969 Ford Mustang Mach 1 was first delivered with Gulfstream Aqua paintwork, a black interior, and a 351ci V8 linked to a FMX automatic.
